description: This file defines a utility class MathUtil with static methods for handling 2D arrays, including copying, summing, setting all elements, and squaring a value.

classes.name: MathUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for 2D array operations and mathematical calculations.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a 2D double array.

methods.name: sumArray
methods.description: Calculates the sum of all elements in a 2D double array.

methods.name: setArray2D
methods.description: Sets all elements in a 2D double array to a specified value.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Returns the square of a given value.
